_note: Enemy hordes per room (src/dungeon/hordes.gd). quota: enemies a room sends in total, alive: how many may live at once; both rise linearly from floor 1 to floor 10 and stay at the floor-10 value after. The room's authored opening group counts towards the quota; waves of wave_min-wave_max follow every wave_interval seconds from spots between spawn_distance and spawn_max_distance px from the nearest hero (out of sight preferred). Boss rooms use boss_room_scale of the quota for adds. A room is quiet once its quota is spent and everything is dead; leaving early returns the living to the quota. exp_scale multiplies every kill's EXP so the larger hordes keep the level pace (Ultimate near floor 5).
